contentPattern: Single-instance toolbar. Row 1 (optional): asset title as plain text. Row 2: one or more download links (one link = direct Download button; two or more, e.g. High-Res / Low-Res, = Download menu). The favourite (add to cart) toggle and the share popover (Facebook, X, LinkedIn, email built from the page URL) are generated, not authored.

optionNotes.titled-bar: Dark translucent bar with the asset title on the left and white outline Download, favourite and share on the right.

usage.description: Press-release and asset pages: the Download / favourite / share toolbar under an article title, a lone favourite star, an asset title bar with actions, or a lone share control.

reuseGuidance: Use wherever an asset or press release needs download, favourite and share actions. Other blocks (media-image, columns-press-image) import buildActions() from this block to render the same toolbar; do not re-implement it.
